description: A bad translation went live and was only partially corrected. The team now needs to reconstruct what changed, what still contains the old wording, and which assets were rolled back versus manually patched. All products are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old quality lead responsible for post-release language corrections
user_profile.context: The immediate fix reduced the user-facing problem, but no one can yet say with confidence where the bad wording still survives
user_profile.communication_style: Forensic and detail-heavy, wants before-and-after differences made explicit

fact_sheet.fact: The faulty German translation was deployed to production in build #8451 on October 26, 2023, at 14:00 UTC.
The first user report of the issue was logged via customer support ticket #7811-A4 on October 26, 2023, at 14:15 UTC.
Jira ticket LOC-1138 was created by Localization Manager Leo Valdez to track the incident on October 26, 2023, at 14:25 UTC.
A hotfix patch for the Zenith Wallet iOS app was deployed to the App Store with build #8452 on October 26, 2023, at 16:30 UTC.
The English source string key is 'wallet.balance.label' with the text 'Current Balance'.
The correct German translation for 'wallet.balance.label' is 'Guthaben'.
The incorrect German translation published was 'Gleichgewicht'.
The incorrect translation originated from the LingoSphere TMS project ID 'ZW-Mobile-Q4-2023'.
The incorrect translation was approved by an automated quality check rule, Rule-ID: GLOSSARY-CHECK-07b, which had a misconfigured termbase.
The Zenith Wallet iOS app, version 3.5.1, was affected by the incorrect translation.
The Zenith Wallet Android app, version 3.5.0, still contains the incorrect translation.
The NovaPay Gateway web portal, using the de-DE.json file from CDN version v2.1.4, still contains the incorrect translation.
The specific iOS file containing the error was `Localizable.strings` for the `de-DE` locale.
The specific Android file that still contains the error is `res/values-de/strings.xml`.
The fix for the iOS app was a manual patch, not a full rollback of the release.
The manual patch for iOS involved directly editing the `Localizable.strings` file in Git commit `e4f5g6h`.
The faulty translation was reverted in the LingoSphere TMS at 17:00 UTC on October 26, 2023, to prevent use in future exports.
No rollback or patch was performed for the Android app; the fix is scheduled for the next release, v3.5.1, on November 2, 2023.
The CDN cache for the NovaPay Gateway web portal has not been purged; the old `de-DE.json` file is still being served.
The bad translation was introduced into the `main` branch via Git commit `a1b2c3d`.
The original deployment containing the bad translation was part of Pull Request #2048 in the `mobile-app-ios` repository.
The Jenkins build job that deployed the faulty translation is named `ios-release-pipeline`.
The LingoSphere TMS can be accessed by authorized personnel at https://zenith.lingosphere.com.
The Jira ticket LOC-1138 is assigned to Anya Sharma, the Quality Lead, for post-mortem analysis.
Leo Valdez, the Localization Manager, is the designated incident commander for LOC-1138.
Chen Wei, Lead Mobile Engineer, executed the manual patch for the iOS application and can be reached at workstation 4B-11.
Sofia Rossi, the backend engineer responsible for the NovaPay Gateway, was not included in the initial incident response.
All real-time communication regarding the incident is archived in the Slack channel `#l10n-incidents`.
A post-mortem meeting is scheduled for October 30, 2023, at 15:00 UTC via Google Meet link meet.google.com/xyz-abc-def.
As of October 27, 2023, the incorrect term 'Gleichgewicht' is still live on the Zenith Wallet Android app and the NovaPay Gateway web portal for all German-speaking users.
